mapper.select: /* common.mpvo.selectMasterMpVoVocProgressStatePop */ SELECT A.VC_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND SYS_TYPE=A.SYS_TYPE AND BUSINESS_COND LIKE '%B%') AS BUYER_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.CD_USER_ID AND SYS_TYPE='KA') AS CD_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS CD_DATE, A.PO_NO, A.REQ_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.REQ_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS REQ_DATE, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.DS_USER_ID AND SYS_TYPE='KA') AS DS_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.DF_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS DF_DATE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC01' AND CODE = A.CLAIM_TYPE) AS CLAIM_TEXT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC02' AND CODE = A.RECV_FLAG) AS RECV_FLAG_TEXT, A.REQ_REMARK, A.DS_REMARK_A, A.DS_REMARK_B, A.DS_REMARK_C, A.DF_REMARK, A.DS_DEPT, A.CLAIM_TYPE, A.RECV_FLAG, A.CD_USER_ID, A.DS_USER_ID, A.BUYER, A.CLAIM_GRADE, A.REQ_USER_ID, A.IMPUTE_TYPE, A.IMPUTE_AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.IMPUTE_AGENT AND SYS_TYPE=A.SYS_TYPE AND BUSINESS_COND LIKE '%S%') AS AGENT_NAME, A.REQ_USER_TEL, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC03' AND CODE = A.CLAIM_MASTER) AS CLAIM_MASTER_TEXT, A.MRO_AREA_TEXT, TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'HH24:MI') AS CD_TIME, TO_CHAR(A.REQ_DATE,'HH24:MI') AS REQ_TIME, (SELECT TEXT3 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='VC01' AND CODE=A.CLAIM_TYPE) AS CLAIM_KIND, A.SYS_TYPE, A.CLAIM_MASTER, TO_CHAR(A.DS_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DS_DATE, (SELECT MAX(B.REVISION) FROM KEP_VOC_REVISION B WHERE B.VC_NO = A.VC_NO) AS REVISION, (SELECT CMPY.BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE= A.BUYER) AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE, TO_CHAR(A.PH_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS PH_DATE, A.REQ_IMAGE_KEY, A.DS_IMAGE_KEY, A.FEEDBACK_IMAGE_KEY FROM KEPAVCDT A WHERE A.VC_NO = #{st_vc_no} AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer}

/* common.mpvo.selectMasterMpVoVocProgressStateFBPop */ SELECT A.VC_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND SYS_TYPE=A.SYS_TYPE AND BUSINESS_COND LIKE '%B%') AS BUYER_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.CD_USER_ID AND SYS_TYPE='KA') AS CD_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS CD_DATE, A.PO_NO, A.REQ_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.REQ_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS REQ_DATE, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.DS_USER_ID AND SYS_TYPE='KA') AS DS_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.DF_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS DF_DATE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC01' AND CODE = A.CLAIM_TYPE) AS CLAIM_TEXT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC02' AND CODE = A.RECV_FLAG) AS RECV_FLAG_TEXT, A.REQ_REMARK, A.DS_REMARK_A, A.DS_REMARK_B, A.DS_REMARK_C, A.DF_REMARK, A.DS_DEPT, A.CLAIM_TYPE, A.RECV_FLAG, A.CD_USER_ID, A.DS_USER_ID, A.BUYER, A.CLAIM_GRADE, A.REQ_USER_ID, A.IMPUTE_TYPE, A.IMPUTE_AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.IMPUTE_AGENT AND SYS_TYPE=A.SYS_TYPE AND BUSINESS_COND LIKE '%S%') AS AGENT_NAME, A.REQ_USER_TEL, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC03' AND CODE = A.CLAIM_MASTER) AS CLAIM_MASTER, A.MRO_AREA_TEXT, DECODE(A.IMPUTE_TYPE,'SS','공급사','MS','KeP/공급사','MM','KeP','ET','기타') AS IMPUTE_TEXT, TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'HH24:MI') AS CD_TIME, TO_CHAR(A.REQ_DATE,'HH24:MI') AS REQ_TIME, NVL(A.MAIL_SEND_FLAG, 'Y') AS MAIL_SEND_FLAG, A.REQ_IMAGE_KEY, A.DS_IMAGE_KEY, A.FEEDBACK_IMAGE_KEY FROM KEPAVCDT A WHERE A.VC_NO = #{st_vc_no} AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer}
mapper.update: /* common.mpvo.updateMasterMpVoVocProgressStateReReqPop */ UPDATE KEPAVCDT SET RECV_FLAG = 'PS', DS_USER_ID = #{st_ds_user_id}, DF_DATE='', DS_DATE='', RE_REQ_USER_ID =#{st_user_id}, RE_REQ_NOTE =#{st_re_req_note}, RE_REQ_DATE = SYSDATE, DF_REMARK = '', DS_REMARK_A ='', DS_REMARK_B ='', DS_REMARK_C ='', DS_CHANGE_FLAG = #{st_ds_change_flag}, DS_CHANGE_DATE = DECODE(#{st_ds_change_flag},'Y',SYSDATE,''), CLAIM_MASTER = #{st_claim_master}, CLAIM_TYPE = #{st_claim_type}, DS_DEPT = #{st_ds_dept_id} WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND VC_NO = #{st_vc_no} AND REQ_USER_ID = #{st_req_user_id} AND RECV_FLAG <> 'FB'

mapper.select: /* common.mpvo.selectMpVoVocHistPop */ SELECT A.VC_NO, A.REVISION, A.STATUS, A.REQ_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(A.REQ_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS REQ_DATE, A.REQ_NOTE, A.SEND_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(A.SEND_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS SEND_DATE, A.SEND_NOTE, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.REQ_USER_ID AND SYS_TYPE='KA') AS REQ_USER_NM, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.SEND_USER_ID AND SYS_TYPE='KA') AS SEND_USER_NM FROM KEP_VOC_REVISION A WHERE VC_NO = #{st_vo_no} ORDER BY A.REVISION DESC
